$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the summary's oracle.sources is an empty array. Every other oracle
field is right, so the run resolved the epic and then failed to say which document it resolved, and
the one check that reads sources is the one that fails. It pins the basename match: the check asks
whether any source's basename is the epic's, so an empty list is a miss and no path convention could
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED, as seeded-correct-run's with one field emptied.
derivation: Everything but oracle.sources is seeded-correct-run's and derives the same way.
Oracle resolution is seven checks: collection_mode, inventory_basis, oracle.resolution_mode,
oracle.confidence, the sources check, oracle.external_pointer_status and oracle.synthetic. The sources
check expects true and computes whether some entry's basename equals
epic-4-tenant-data-export-and-erasure.md; over an empty array that is false. 6 of 7.
